basics.name: Kenton Smeltzer
basics.headline: Principal Systems Engineer & AI Solutions Architect | RAG pipelines, Agentic Workflows, and High-Scale Enterprise Systems
basics.summary: Principal Systems Engineer, AI Solutions Architect, and former CTO with over 20 years of experience designing high-scale, secure, and distributed enterprise platforms. Translating executive strategy into hands-on enterprise implementation. Expertise spans building global reservation engines (Marriott, Orlando.com), secure healthcare data platforms (DexCare), and complex federal investigation systems (Joint Interagency Task Force). Recently focused on architecting advanced RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and distributed event-driven systems, with a foundation in adversarial modeling and spatial intelligence tracing back to DoD simulators in 1998.

generation_rules: Never categorize Node.js, React, or Kubernetes as a programming language. They are frameworks/runtimes.
Treat Open Policy Agent (OPA) as Cloud & Infrastructure / Security tooling, NOT as Artificial Intelligence.

CRITICAL: The "Points of Note" section (comprising ALL patents and distinctions from the KB) and the "Projects", "Education", & "Certifications" sections MUST be included in their entirety. You are strictly FORBIDDEN from filtering, summarizing, or omitting ANY item from these arrays, regardless of how relevant you think they are to the specific job description. If it exists in the KB, it MUST be on the resume.

CRITICAL: The Technical Skills section must be aggressively curated. ONLY include skills explicitly requested in the Job Description or highly relevant adjacent technologies. Cap the skills section at 15-20 total skills to prevent keyword stuffing. DO NOT dump the entire skills database.

experience.title: Principal AI Architect & Creator
bullets: Direct independent open-source research and development dedicated to advancing autonomous AI agent capabilities, adversarial validation, and cognitive memory architectures.

Engineered NeuroStrata, a Cognitive Memory Architecture for Agents written in Rust, featuring a specialized 3-tier memory namespace (Global, Domain, Task) and vector search capabilities utilizing LanceDB, Qdrant, and KuzuDB (a graph-vector hybrid).
Architected NeuroCortex, a Cognitive Deterministic Engine (CDE) built in Rust that provides adversarial feedback to reduce LLM agent hallucinations by up to 90%.
Developed NeuroPlasticity, a Self-Reinforced Testing Framework (SRTF) in Rust for AI agents to self-learn and validate behaviors.

Created NeuroGenesis, an AI Architecture Compiler (AAC) shell script that scaffolds customized adversarial panels chaired by evidence-backed agent specialists. Automated the LLM model evaluation and selection process for adversarial panel generation, ensuring optimal agent specialization and token efficiency.

experience.title: AI & Security Solutions Consultant (Contract)
bullets: Led the Digital Self Service (DSS) innovation incubator and established the AI Center of Excellence (COE) as Principal AI and security consultant. Established standardized architectural controls via Spec Kit and mentored enterprise engineering teams on AI adoption. Directed the AI strategic vision for the DSS organization, mentoring engineering teams through structured lunch-and-learn educational sessions, and defining strict enterprise AI governance and adoption standards.

Orchestrated a Databricks AI workflow and complex agent orchestration patterns to analyze customer phone calls in real-time—automatically tagging life events and surfacing targeted financial opportunities to live agents.

Engineered custom AI orchestration tools (via OpenCode) to modernize the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including an automated 7-persona AI Architecture Review Panel, an AI-driven PR analyzer, an intelligent technical interview scribe, and an AI requirements review tool for Azure DevOps.

Delivered policy-driven, customer-facing application security frameworks utilizing Open Policy Agent (OPA) alongside secure RAG pipelines (Azure AI, Bedrock, Vertex), bridging rapid innovation with strict financial compliance (SOC 2, PII, Model Risk Governance).
Implemented Headless Drupal to decouple content delivery from the frontend, establishing a scalable Server-Driven UI pattern for financial and compliance-heavy applications.
Integrated LaunchDarkly experimentation platforms into the digital self-service workflow, driving targeted personalization and mitigating deployment risk through controlled rollouts.
Evaluated, benchmarked, and selected foundational LLMs (Claude, GPT, Vertex), matching specific model capabilities, latency profiles, and token costs to precise enterprise application requirements.
Architected and scaled production AI workflows and secure RAG pipelines utilizing Azure Foundry, implementing best-practice cloud-native infrastructure for enterprise LLM inference.
Engineered intelligent, multi-agent systems employing ReAct (Reasoning and Acting) execution logic via the Rig framework in Rust, enabling autonomous orchestration of complex enterprise workflows.

Architected a real-time, plugin-based signal processing engine in Go, utilizing NATS JetStream as the event broker to process over 10,000 requests per second, extending event streams directly to the frontend via WebSockets.

Delivered the initial production release of a unified pre-call intelligence dashboard for agents by integrating disparate event-based APIs, including Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) and Genesys.
Engineered an LLM-backed in-call monitoring system utilizing vector embeddings to identify and surface critical life event signals (e.g., retirement, marriage) with sub-50ms latency.
Automated real-time compliance workflows by dynamically surfacing required disclosures based on in-call semantic triggers, establishing a formalized audit trail for a newly launched product.

Engineered a 100% automated agentic GitHub workflow to autonomously resolve SonarQube, Snyk, and accessibility defects. Implemented an adversarial LLM panel architecture—pairing a specialized coding model with a strict verification model—to generate and review pull requests, shifting human-in-the-loop (HITL) intervention strictly to final approval.
Managed technical systems within a specialized fintech environment, developing targeted solutions to support 401K management operations and ensure reliable financial data processing.

experience.title: AI & Systems Engineering Consultant
bullets: Engineered real-time, event-based geospatial coordination systems for Military, Police, and Fire Operations.
Architected distributed event-based infrastructure utilizing MQTT, MQTT over WebSockets, and AMQP to synchronize web, mobile, and IoT devices.
Applied AI solutions to real-time field audio communications and geospatial logistics to enhance situational awareness and deployment efficiency.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer / Director of Special Projects
bullets: Engineered full stack healthcare solutions for major medical providers (Kaiser Permanente, Piedmont, CHN) using Node, Golang, Python, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and Postgres on AWS. Developed AI agent workflows utilizing Retool, Grok/GPT APIs, Node-RED, and n8n., LangChain, and LangGraph.
Authored pending patent (US20250103405A1) for a distributed, event-based data platform handling healthcare operations.
Delivered a best-in-class patient matching algorithm that significantly reduced duplicate record rates while maintaining strict Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance.
Led the DevCare effort to develop ephemeral developer environments, spinning up DexCare’s entire software suite pinned to specific versions using Kubernetes and Rancher Desktop.
Modernized DexCare's Universal Authentication solution at the transport layer, reducing application complexity and streamlining enterprise testing and security.
Acted as the primary mentor and instructor for the development organization, designing and hosting educational sessions, 1-on-1 mentorship, and workshops.

Architected robust A/B testing and feature-flagging infrastructure using LaunchDarkly, enabling progressive delivery and dynamic personalization across the healthcare platform without deploying new code.

Engineered intelligent, AI-powered external API workflows (HTTP REST, gRPC, and non-RPC event-oriented interfaces) enabling deep operational integrations for major hospital conglomerates including Kaiser Permanente, CHN, Piedmont, and Providence.
Scaled high-volume AI inference and LLM agent workloads utilizing cloud-native patterns and AI-specific data pipelines on Amazon Bedrock.
Architected agentic workflows and AI-enabled service integrations utilizing Python, LangChain, and LangGraph to orchestrate complex healthcare data pipelines.
Architected and deployed the agentic telemetry strategy, directing the rollout and fine-tuning of the LangSmith deployment
Architected advanced ReAct and Plan-and-Execute agentic workflows utilizing LangChain and LangGraph to drive autonomous healthcare data pipelines and API integrations.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer / Government Projects Lead
bullets: Directed a 15-person cross-functional engineering team utilizing Node.js, React, and Clojure to deliver massive data aggregation platforms and inter-agency integration.

Architected smart contract tracing tools for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Monero, exposing implementation vulnerabilities and identifying black market activity to aid joint agencies in interdicting major trafficking events.
Developed AI agents to aid joint agencies in investigating and interdicting major human and drug trafficking events.

experience.title: Enterprise Architect / CTO
bullets: Delivered full stack development consultancy for clients including Gartner, eCollege, EuroRSCG, and IBM. Designed and developed JavaScript-based web applications, mobile solutions, and Java middleware utilizing React, Node.js, Angular, Dojo, Backbone.js, REST, Java, JEE, and Salesforce.com.

Designed and developed the front-end strategy for IBM Jam, a social conference platform utilized by NATO and the UN. Built core Dojo and JavaScript-based modules for forum, network, profile, and chat functionalities.

Engineered the IBM Social Media Aggregator (SMA) to aggregate social content (blogs, Twitter, Facebook, Flickr, YouTube) via web services. Designed and implemented the complete Dojo-based UI to display conference content feeds.
Architected and launched Nibble.Fish, a mobile-first intelligent fishing companion application featuring on-device vision classifiers.
Engineered cross-platform mobile experiences for iOS and Android utilizing Flutter and Dart, with deep integrations to native Swift and Kotlin layers.
Designed a scalable backend infrastructure using Golang, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ deployed via Podman.

Architected the Key West Health digital platform utilizing Server-Driven UI (SDUI) principles and a modern Headless CMS architecture, enabling non-technical stakeholders to control complex page structures.

Engineered Nibble.Fish, a Flutter-based mobile application integrating a custom-trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based on MobileNetV2 for automated fish species detection and length measurement. Architected the training pipeline utilizing Python, PyTorch, and TorchVision to deliver real-time regulatory recommendations.
Implemented Reflexion mechanisms and Grouped Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enhance structural understanding and model self-correction within the Nibble.Fish AI pipeline.

experience.title: Senior Director of Technology
bullets: Directed architecture and development requirements for a 50-person cross-functional technical organization encompassing developers, test engineers, QA, and PMs. Architected the realignment of Release Management and implemented proper Source Code Management (SCM) tools, resulting in a standardized knowledge base, formally defined delivery processes, and a measurable improvement in overall software quality across a massive enterprise technology footprint (Java, JEE, WebSphere, Oracle, MSSQL, JavaScript).
Presented emerging web technologies as a guest speaker at IBM Impact 2009, discussing how to position the enterprise to take advantage of the changing industry standards.
Led initiative to convert the entire web-reservation system over to a modern browser application that was built on top of Dojo, Require.js, JAX-RS and RESTful services.

Salvaged project with a 10 million dollar overrun. Redesigned the system to account for legacy system performance issues, salvaging as much new development as possible, while completing the project in 4 months.
Implemented new package and preview booking site utilizing web 2.0 and rich internet application technologies such as the Dojo Toolkit, REST and JAX-RS.

Modernized the enterprise service bus (Enterprise Service Bus (ESB)) strategy as well as the legacy application service architecture to convert the enterprise’s IT offerings into a Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA).
Orchestrated strategy to build out of legacy systems while maintaining an existing level of service.

Delivered the organization's source control management strategy, implemented new source code management systems and processes to allow developers to use distributed source code management (Mercurial) while build and release managers maintained the base line in Subversion. Integrated defect tracking into the development process to ensure that all source code commits referred back to a ticket.
Modernized the WebSphere, MSSQL, and Oracle infrastructure, establishing a highly available clustered environment that supported global enterprise scale.
Created a Standards and Conventions process for architectural documents (UML diagrams, Sequence diagrams, Entity Relationship diagram, Use Cases) as well as coding standards.

Provided architecture and development requirements for the web development team, translating business requirements into software blueprints. Managed defect resource assignment and led efforts to identify and implement proper Source Code Management (SCM) tools.
Led enterprise-wide PCI compliance initiatives across all technical systems, executing data scrubbing protocols and integrating secure payment gateways to establish audit observation frameworks.

experience.title: CTO / Director of Engineering
bullets: Directed a 50-person global engineering organization (US, Spain, India), acting as the primary liaison between executive leadership and offshore teams to establish enterprise software standards and ensure unabridged information flow post-acquisition.
Architected the strategic escape from a proprietary, closed-source legacy RTO system (FoxPro) that was financially and technologically constraining the business.

Engineered a bidirectional data synchronization layer between the black-box legacy system and MS SQL Server, successfully applying the Strangler Fig pattern to systematically build modern internet-native capabilities.
Decommissioned the legacy RTO infrastructure, eliminating license costs and enabling massive modernization efforts.
Architected and delivered high-volume, public-facing external APIs supplying real-time hotel night inventory to major Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) including Expedia, Travelocity, and Hotels.com.
Established API interfaces as a core product surface, optimizing external Developer Experience (DX) for hundreds of global integration partners.

experience.title: CTO / Principal Engineer
bullets: Directed all technical strategy and hands-on architecture for a lean, 4-person engineering team, scaling the startup from inception to an acquisition by Hotels.com in just two years.
Engineered a 100% automated operational pipeline, eliminating IT bottlenecks by building self-serve tools and dashboards that empowered sales and operations teams to fully own their data domains.
Designed and launched the core web property and high-volume hotel booking engine in just two months through rapid feedback-loop programming and deep cross-departmental shadowing.

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Orchestrated an enterprise Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) / Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) platform acting as a digital microkernel, successfully treating external R&D, manufacturing, and ad agencies as pluggable components in the supply chain.

Directed an 8-person engineering team to design and deploy an integrated Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system, unifying operations across a core 50-person organization and disparate vendor warehouses.
Engineered a centralized data hub that streamlined cross-organizational workflows, allowing marketing agencies to query formulation and target market data without direct R&D interaction.
Delivered the core e-commerce presence, marketing systems, and online transaction payment engines for the dietary supplement distributor.

experience.title: Sr. Simulations Developer / Team Lead
bullets: Directed the architecture and design of 3D simulation software, level design, and AI logic using C++, Java, and OpenGL.
Designed an enemy combatant AI system that mimicked maneuvers to realistically emulate enemy strategies on the battlefield.
Mentored developers and managed day-to-day tasks while delivering hands-on development utilizing Open Inventor, VRML, and Mathematica.

experience.title: Senior Developer
bullets: Architected and deployed mass-scale distributed training and simulation systems for the Naval F-14 and F-18 fighter jets.
Designed 3D models and integration processes for computer-based military training systems.
Evaluated and implemented new technologies to establish development processes and conventions around newly adopted tools.
